offline.title: No VU1 hub connected
offline.intro: The dials below show what VU Studio would display. To bring the real ones to life:
offline.step1: Plug the VU1 hub into a USB port: VU Studio finds it on its own.
offline.step2: Close the official VU-Server and any other app that talks to the hub: only one program at a time can use its serial port.
offline.step3: No hardware at hand? Start the service with {{flag}} to try VU Studio with four simulated dials.

empty.title: No dials to show yet

lost.title: Can't reach the VU Studio service
lost.text: Make sure the service is running. This page reconnects by itself as soon as it's back.
